# SETAEI

> SETAEI is the personal technology house of Khabat Setaei, based in Oslo, Norway. Khabat works as a CTO, AI developer, SaaS developer, full-stack developer and SEO expert, and SETAEI also delivers professional websites, e-commerce, landing pages and AI automation to Norwegian businesses.

This file is a plain-language index for AI assistants and crawlers. It does not affect Google rankings — it is a courtesy index, not an SEO mechanism.

- [AI automasjon](https://setai.no/services/ai-automation/): business process automation
